howItWorks.step1Desc: Enter the phone number you want to locate and customize the SMS message you want the recipient to receive.

features.title: Why choose Tracify?
features.subtitle: One click and zero effort to find anyone's location across the globe
features.feature1Desc: While the phone's owner will be informed of a location request, the requester's identity remains confidential. All geolocation requests are made with respect to privacy, and transmitted data is encrypted for security.
features.feature2Desc: There's no software to install on your phone or the targeted device. Everything operates remotely! Just input the phone number you wish to track. As soon as the SMS recipient provides consent, you'll have immediate access.
features.feature3Desc: Tracify works with all networks worldwide. However, successful tracking requires the phone to be on, service availability, and the SMS recipient's explicit consent to share their location.
features.feature4Desc: Tracify seamlessly supports both iOS and Android mobile devices. As long as you have the phone number and the individual's explicit approval to track, you can locate them using our service.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here you can find all the answers to the questions we are most often asked about our mobile geolocation service, Tracify.
faq.a1: Tracify is a mobile geolocation service that allows you to locate any phone number worldwide. Our service works by sending an SMS to the target phone requesting location sharing consent. Once consent is given, you receive the precise GPS coordinates.
faq.q2: Is it even legal to use the Tracify phone number tracker?
faq.a2: Yes, Tracify is completely legal because it requires explicit consent from the person being tracked. The recipient must actively agree to share their location by responding to the SMS request. We comply with all privacy regulations and data protection laws.
faq.a3: Tracify supports all major mobile networks worldwide. Whether the target phone uses GSM, CDMA, LTE, or 5G networks, our service can send location requests to any valid phone number.
faq.q4: Can I track the location of the phone number if I don't know its model?
faq.a4: Absolutely! You don't need to know the phone model, manufacturer, or operating system. All you need is the phone number. Our system automatically handles all the technical details regardless of the device type.
faq.q5: Does Tracify support both iOS and Android operated mobile devices?
faq.a5: Yes, Tracify works with both iOS (iPhone) and Android devices. Our SMS-based location request system is compatible with any smartphone that can receive text messages and has location services available.
faq.q6: How fast can Tracify find the location of a phone number?
faq.a6: Once the SMS recipient consents to share their location, you'll receive the coordinates almost instantly. The total time depends on how quickly the recipient responds to the location request.
faq.q7: How to track a phone number without physical access to the target device?
faq.a7: Simply enter the phone number in our system, customize your message, and we'll send an SMS requesting location consent. Everything is done remotely - no physical access to the target device is ever required.
faq.q8: Can I track someone by cell phone number?
faq.a8: Yes, but only with their explicit consent. Tracify sends a location request via SMS, and tracking only occurs when the recipient agrees to share their location. This ensures privacy and legal compliance.

privacy.cardSubtitle: We are committed to protecting your personal information.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Tracify ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website at tracify-geo.com and our phone location tracking services. By using our services, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.

dataCollection.title: 2. Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect the following types of information:
dataCollection.item1: Account Information: Email address, name, and password when you register
dataCollection.item2: Payment Information: Credit card details processed securely through Stripe
dataCollection.item3: Phone Numbers: Numbers you submit for location tracking requests
dataCollection.item4: Location Data: GPS coordinates shared by consenting recipients
dataCollection.item5: Usage Data: How you interact with our service, including IP address and browser type

dataUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
dataUse.content: We use your information for the following purposes:
dataUse.item1: To provide and maintain our location tracking service
dataUse.item2: To process your payments and manage your subscription
dataUse.item3: To send SMS location requests to the phone numbers you provide
dataUse.item4: To communicate with you about your account and service updates
dataUse.item5: To improve our services and develop new features

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing and Third Parties
dataSharing.content1: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
dataSharing.item1: Stripe: Our payment processor, for handling transactions securely
dataSharing.item2: SMS Providers: To deliver location request messages
dataSharing.item3: Legal Authorities: When required by law or to protect our rights
dataSharing.content2: All third-party providers are contractually obligated to protect your data.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information:
dataSecurity.item1: SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmission
dataSecurity.item4: Limited employee access to personal data
dataSecurity.note: Note: While we take extensive precautions, no internet transmission is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

userRights.title: 6. Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
userRights.item1: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
userRights.item2: Correction: Request correction of inaccurate data
userRights.item3: Deletion: Request deletion of your account and associated data
userRights.item4: Portability: Request your data in a portable format
userRights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at support@tracify-geo.com.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content1: We use cookies and similar technologies to:
cookies.item1: Keep you logged into your account
cookies.item3: Analyze website traffic and usage patterns
cookies.content2: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some features of our service.

dataRetention.title: 8. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. After account deletion, we may retain certain data for legal compliance, dispute resolution, or legitimate business purposes for up to 90 days.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: Tracify is not intended for use by individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover that a child has provided us with personal information, we will delete it promptly.
